read.thesis: Q2 CY26 sales up 24% to $20.5B with volume +$3.1B and price +$595M; adjusted margin 21.9% vs 17.6%, but P&E and RI cite higher period manufacturing costs and no capacity figures were disclosed.

triggers.label: Sales up 24% to $20.5B
triggers.quote: Second-quarter 2026 sales and revenues increased 24% to $20.5 billion

triggers.label: Dealer inventory build aided N. America
triggers.quote: Higher sales volume was mainly driven by higher sales of equipment to end users

red_flags.label: Period manufacturing cost headwind in P&E and RI
red_flags.quote: Unfavorable manufacturing costs largely reflected increased period manufacturing costs.

red_flags.label: Tariff recovery one-off flatters Q2 profit
red_flags.quote: Operating profit in the second quarter of 2026 included $392 million of expected International Emergency Economic Power Act (IEEPA) tariff recoveries.
